description: Tunable operating policy for the powerful-work-splitter skill tool. Every threshold, weight, and bound used by the planner, checkpoint controller, file contract, and gate validator is read from this file so behaviour can be changed without editing code.

budget.units_per_stage_overhead_note: stage_overhead_units is charged per stage inside estimate_counts

stage_blueprints.title: Discovery and requirement lock
stage_blueprints.objective: Normalize the request, lock the requirement ledger, and inventory every named or attached file.

stage_blueprints.title: Input and file contract
stage_blueprints.objective: Validate inputs, detect missing or damaged files, and confirm the evidence base before building.

stage_blueprints.title: Research and evidence
stage_blueprints.objective: Gather and record the evidence each requirement depends on before any drafting or building.

stage_blueprints.title: Core build and drafting
stage_blueprints.objective: Produce the primary artifacts that satisfy the assigned requirements.

stage_blueprints.title: Integration and cross-checks
stage_blueprints.objective: Merge partial artifacts, resolve naming and format drift, and cross-check requirement coverage.

stage_blueprints.title: Verification and quality gates
stage_blueprints.objective: Run acceptance tests, gate evidence checks, and defect repair loops on the assembled work.

single_stage.title: Execute and deliver in one response
single_stage.objective: Complete every requirement, verify each deliverable, and deliver in this single response.

assembly_stage.title: Final assembly and delivery
assembly_stage.objective: Combine stage outputs, resolve inconsistencies, reopen every artifact, remove temporary material, and deliver the verified package.
